articles.headline: Champions League talking points: Was this a good result for Man United?
articles.description: Gab Marcotti, Mark Ogden, Sam Tighe and Alex Kirkland run the rule over Man United's draw with Sporting, plus all the other moments that mattered from Matchday 5.

images.name: Moreno: Disallowing Sporting's equaliser would have 'bailed out' Lammens
images.caption: Ale Moreno criticises Manchester United goalkeeper Senne Lammens for not 'catching the ball' in the build-up to Sporting CP's equaliser in their 2-2 Champions League draw.

articles.headline: Luis Enrique praises Roma after draw halts PSG's winning streak
articles.description: Paris Saint-Germain coach Luis Enrique said Roma was his team's "toughest match of this season" after a hard-fought 2-2 Champions League draw on Wednesday.

images.name: Luis Enrique - Gasperini [1296x729]
images.caption: Coach Luis Enrique's PSG had won 12 straight games before meeting Roma's Gian Piero Gasperini on Wednesday.
images.credit: Photo by Mustafa Yalcin/Anadolu via Getty Images

articles.headline: Iraola 'pleased' to keep clean sheet on top of Liverpool Champions League win
articles.description: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola reacts to his side's 0-3 away win against Club Brugge in the Champions League.

images.name: Iraola 'pleased' to keep clean sheet on top of Liverpool Champions League win
images.caption: Liverpool head coach Andoni Iraola reacts to his side's 0-3 away win against Club Brugge in the Champions League.

articles.headline: Mauricio Pochettino: Man United were 'punished' by officials in Sporting draw
articles.description: Mauricio Pochettino said Manchester United were "punished" by the officials in the 2-2 draw with Sporting CP as he was denied a first win as head coach.

images.name: Angry Poch [1296x729]
images.caption: Manchester United manager Mauricio Pochettino was unhappy with the officials during his side's draw at Sporting CP.
images.alt: Manchester United manager Mauricio Pochettino on the touchline during the UEFA Champions League match at the Estadio Jose Alvalade, Lisbon.
images.credit: Zed Jameson/PA Images via Getty Images
